// Add regression tests here.

test "clamp covers all branches and exact endpoints" {
  assert clamp(-8, -7, 12) == -7
  assert clamp(-7, -7, 12) == -7
  assert clamp(-6, -7, 12) == -6
  assert clamp(0, -7, 12) == 0
  assert clamp(11, -7, 12) == 11
  assert clamp(12, -7, 12) == 12
  assert clamp(13, -7, 12) == 12
}

test "clamp handles positive and negative intervals" {
  assert clamp(-9, 3, 8) == 3
  assert clamp(2, 3, 8) == 3
  assert clamp(3, 3, 8) == 3
  assert clamp(5, 3, 8) == 5
  assert clamp(8, 3, 8) == 8
  assert clamp(9, 3, 8) == 8
  assert clamp(-13, -12, -4) == -12
  assert clamp(-12, -12, -4) == -12
  assert clamp(-9, -12, -4) == -9
  assert clamp(-4, -12, -4) == -4
  assert clamp(-3, -12, -4) == -4
  assert clamp(9, -12, -4) == -4
}

test "clamp handles equal and adjacent bounds" {
  assert clamp(-1, 0, 0) == 0
  assert clamp(0, 0, 0) == 0
  assert clamp(1, 0, 0) == 0
  assert clamp(5, 6, 6) == 6
  assert clamp(6, 6, 6) == 6
  assert clamp(7, 6, 6) == 6
  assert clamp(-7, -6, -6) == -6
  assert clamp(-6, -6, -6) == -6
  assert clamp(-5, -6, -6) == -6
  assert clamp(-2, -1, 0) == -1
  assert clamp(-1, -1, 0) == -1
  assert clamp(0, -1, 0) == 0
  assert clamp(1, -1, 0) == 0
}

test "clamp preserves values across the full signed range" {
  let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  let maximum = 9223372036854775807
  assert clamp(minimum, minimum, maximum) == minimum
  assert clamp(minimum + 1, minimum, maximum) == minimum + 1
  assert clamp(-1, minimum, maximum) == -1
  assert clamp(0, minimum, maximum) == 0
  assert clamp(1, minimum, maximum) == 1
  assert clamp(maximum - 1, minimum, maximum) == maximum - 1
  assert clamp(maximum, minimum, maximum) == maximum
  assert clamp(minimum, -7, 12) == -7
  assert clamp(maximum, -7, 12) == 12
  assert clamp(minimum, 3, maximum) == 3
  assert clamp(maximum, minimum, -3) == -3
}

test "clamp handles intervals at integer limits" {
  let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  let maximum = 9223372036854775807
  assert clamp(minimum, minimum + 1, maximum - 1) == minimum + 1
  assert clamp(maximum, minimum + 1, maximum - 1) == maximum - 1
  assert clamp(minimum, minimum, minimum + 1) == minimum
  assert clamp(minimum + 1, minimum, minimum + 1) == minimum + 1
  assert clamp(minimum + 2, minimum, minimum + 1) == minimum + 1
  assert clamp(maximum - 2, maximum - 1, maximum) == maximum - 1
  assert clamp(maximum - 1, maximum - 1, maximum) == maximum - 1
  assert clamp(maximum, maximum - 1, maximum) == maximum
  assert clamp(minimum, minimum, minimum) == minimum
  assert clamp(minimum + 1, minimum, minimum) == minimum
  assert clamp(maximum, minimum, minimum) == minimum
  assert clamp(maximum, maximum, maximum) == maximum
  assert clamp(maximum - 1, maximum, maximum) == maximum
  assert clamp(minimum, maximum, maximum) == maximum
}
